description: Free. The page shapes: starting points for a whole page by kind (app workspace, dashboard, product reveal, service landing, story, personal homepage, event, shop, game), each with its reader’s job, reading path, first screen, header, structure, phone, motion, what fits and what not to do. Without an id, the list; with an id, the shape in full; with "compose", the method for a page no shape fits, with a worked example. A shape is where to start, never a template: pick one or compose, and name it in your notes.
name: get_shape
title: Get a page shape
